description: Source code for Exotel media stream serializer in Pipecat, handling WebSocket protocol conversion, audio resampling, and DTMF events.

classes.name: ExotelFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Exotel WebSocket media streams, converting frames to/from WebSocket messages, handling audio and DTMF.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with stream and call SIDs, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline sample rate based on StartFrame.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into Exotel WebSocket messages, including media and interruption events.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts Exotel WebSocket messages into Pipecat frames, handling media and DTMF events.
